artifacts.summary: Implementation summary covering all 8 plan phases: BM_CM_1 repair-frontier recording, the oracle budget widening, unstable marker registration/marking/wiring, unstable-watch.yml, TESTING_GUIDE.md 8.9, and the conditional follow-up task.

completion_data.completion_summary: Recorded BM_CM_1's full repair frontier (a third closed encoding avenue) and marked it unstable with all four entry criteria in-line since no fix exists. Landed a measurement-justified widening of the oracle gating re-check budget (20000->40000ms), verified locally at 103/103 conclusive but not yet on real CI. Registered and wired the unstable marker's deselection across tests.yml, differential-tests.yml, release.yml, and flake.nix; added the non-gating unstable-watch.yml observation workflow; documented the full policy in TESTING_GUIDE.md 8.9; and created follow-up task 160 since neither defect fully closed within this round.

memory_candidates.content: For a pytest suite with an ini file that is a sibling (not ancestor) of a standalone test tree (e.g. code/pyproject.toml vs. oracle/), marker registration must be mirrored in BOTH the ini file AND a conftest.py in the standalone tree's own pytest_configure via config.addinivalue_line -- ini-discovery never reaches a sibling directory's ini file, so registering only in the ini file leaves the standalone tree emitting unknown-marker warnings (or erroring under --strict-markers).

When converting a pytest parametrize call from a bare dict.items() view to pytest.param(...) objects (e.g. to attach per-case marks), passing no explicit ids= reproduces the original auto-generated node IDs exactly, verified via a --collect-only diff before/after -- this is the safe way to add a conditional mark to select parametrized cases without breaking existing node-ID-dependent -k selections or CI history.

reflection.what_worked: Reading the research report's measurement tables closely before writing any comment made the in-line entry-criteria and budget-justification blocks fast to draft accurately -- the evidence was already assembled, so the work was transcription with fidelity checks, not re-derivation.
reflection.what_was_hard: The no-task-references-in-deliverables hook blocked the first operators.py docstring edit for citing task numbers in a code comment; had to rewrite the historical cross-references using dates and durable anchors instead.
reflection.what_was_missed: Phases 2 and 3's git adds were batched together before the first commit, merging what the plan intended as two separate phase commits into one -- caught and recorded honestly in the summary rather than silently left unremarked.
reflection.successes: All 8 phases completed and verified: node IDs byte-identical before/after the unstable marking, the widened oracle budget still passes at 103/103 conclusive locally, all workflow YAML parses, the unstable-watch.yml classification logic tested correct against a hand-written TIMING/NEW sample, and TESTING_GUIDE.md 8.9 cross-references all verified to exist.
